 · 29 October 2026 
 Serie A Liveblog: Frosinone vs. Lecce and Fiorentina vs. Atalanta 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens as the Serie A midweek round closes with high-flying Frosinone against Lecce, then an intriguing Fiorentina vs. Atalanta.
 We begin at 17.30 GMT (18.30 CET) with newly-promoted Frosinone who could climb into sixth place just one point shy of Milan in fifth if they beat Lecce.
 OneFootball Videos
 At 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET), Fiorentina in crisis mode host Maurizio Sarri’s stuttering Atalanta.
